source: Tax Code of Ukraine (ПКУ), п. 291.4 (groups, limits as 167/834/1167 minimum wages on 1 January), п. 293.2-293.3 (single-tax rates). Values cross-checked 2026-10-17 against: biz.ligazakon.net/news/224492 (2024: MZP 7 100, PM 3 028, limits 1 185 700 / 5 921 400 / 8 285 700, single tax 302.80 / 1 420); news.dtkt.ua/.../107438 and buhplatforma.com.ua/news/113456 (2025: MZP 8 000, PM 3 028; 2026: MZP 8 647, PM 3 328, limits 1 444 049 / 7 211 598 / 10 091 049, military levy 10% MZP for groups 1-2, 1% income for group 3); biz.ligazakon.net/news/232910 (military levy for single-tax payers from 1 January 2025).
unverified: Exact number and article of the law that introduced the military levy for single-tax FOPs (sources disagree: bill 9319 vs law 4015-IX) — only the start date 2025-01-01 is cross-checked.
Group 1/2 single-tax amounts are the statutory maxima; real rates are set by local councils (modelled as maxima on purpose, stated in the rule text).
Client restrictions are simplified to two flags (businessClients, servicesToGeneralSystemClients); non-residents, budget institutions and excise goods are out of scope.
notes: Same input objects in every version (E4): expected outputs differ only where the version's parameters or structure differ. 2024 has no militaryLevy output (structural change in 2025). Known limitation: the validator compares expected keys only, so a 2025+ table evaluated against 2024 tests does not flag the extra militaryLevy output. 2024 text mentions the 1 April 2024 minimum wage (UAH 8 000) as a distractor without saying it is irrelevant; the rule itself says limits and rates use the value set on 1 January (7 100).
referenceDmn: Human reference written 2026-10-17 in Cowork; checked with a Python re-implementation of the FEEL subset; pending Camunda confirmation (StrictValidator).
